evidence_chain: ASPIRE 在 sec:method (pages 3-7) 引入三个组件：闭环多模态轨迹执行引擎、持续扩展技能库、进化式程序搜索。sec:experiments (pages 7-9) 报告 +77% LIBERO-Pro、+72% Robosuite、+32% BEHAVIOR-1K、31% vs 4% LIBERO-Pro Long 零样本。sec:appendix-c (pages 9-11) 验证三个仿真技能在真实双臂机器人上的可重用性。所有中心声称均有具体页码与具体数字支撑，且与 raw_sections.jsonl 原文一致。
boundaries_checked: real-robot transfer evidence limited to 3 simulation-discovered skills on single bimanual embodiment (sec:limitations pages 11-12)
VLA baselines date back to OpenVLA / pi0 / pi0.5; newer pi0.5-FAST / GR00T-N1 / Helix not benchmarked (sec:limitations + 我的笔记 sec:局限)
compute cost of evolutionary search not reported (我的笔记 sec:局限 + sec:复杂度与扩展性)
no library seeding from human demonstrations (我的笔记 sec:局限)
